holdout_rules.decision: supported_local ONLY when local MSE <= margin * pooled MSE on BOTH the leave-country-out and the leave-era-out paired populations with at least local_floor_effective_n paired keys each; a missing holdout or a plan hash that differs from the card's -> abstain; otherwise pooled_only_borrowed when a pooled cell exists for the region's members
holdout_rules.leave_country_out: every hierarchy member of the region is held out of the pooled fit; the pooled (without-region) and local predictions are scored on the held-out members' paired keys
holdout_rules.leave_era_out: each era is held out of both fits in turn and rows anchored in the held-out era are scored; every era ends before the preregistration reserved_start 2022-01-03 and every row still passes WindowGuard.admit(fold='dev')
holdout_rules.local_effective_n: the largest effective_n among the region's local cells at eval_horizon_bdays; never summed across targets; borrowed_prior_effective_n is reported separately
holdout_rules.no_post_hoc_exception: an unfavourable local outcome is never relabelled an exception; the plan is frozen here

out_of_card_registry_regions.note: registry regions with no T10 row carry no transfer card in v1 (GAP for T20/T24)

t10_source.note: T10 measurement_status qualifies the region's central-bank balance-sheet input; it does not register a local-currency return series. T19 requires both.
